_source.api: Google Ads API v25 googleAds:search (read-only GAQL)
_source.query: SELECT campaign.id, ad_group.id, ad_group_ad.ad.id, ad_group_ad.policy_summary.approval_status, ad_group_ad.policy_summary.policy_topic_entries FROM ad_group_ad WHERE ad_group_ad.status = 'ENABLED' AND ad_group.status = 'ENABLED' AND campaign.status = 'ENABLED' AND ad_group_ad.policy_summary.approval_status IN ('DISAPPROVED', 'APPROVED_LIMITED')
